# balena_application_profile_catalog (Resource)

Catalogs a profile name offered by an application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "balena_application_profile_catalog" "gpu" {
  application_id = 123456
  profile_name   = "gpu"
  description    = "Enables GPU acceleration for the fleet."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the application cataloguing the profile.
- `profile_name` (String) Profile name, between 2 and 100 characters.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the profile, at most 4000 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier assigned by the Balena API.
